verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs say its transaction-monitoring workflows can "generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met," and a deprecation note points users to an Investigations feature. That confirms an investigations capability exists. Nothing shows how alerts are prioritized or how subjects and transactions are grouped into an investigation. Missing for 10: alert prioritization or triage, grouping of multiple subjects and transactions into a case, investigation workflow documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met
These endpoints are deprecated in favor of using Investigations.
